race.comment: BOURBONONTHEROCKS (3) gets the nod after putting together three solid runs to start his career, capped by a Belmont Mdn win as favourite last start. The way he finished off there suggests the mile is no issue. Looks a progressive type who can get over the top to win again. DIXIE DOO (6) finished nicely fresh before a 1.4L defeat last start in a CL3 at Northam. Blinkers go on now for the first time and Parnham sticking is a good move. Wouldn't surprise to see her go to a new level. BELLA VIOLETTA (10) has twice been wider than ideal in CL3 grade this campaign and was only beaten a length and a half last start, so she is well placed if that effort has brought her on third-up. ASTONISHER (9) bumped into a big winner last start but that form can see her feature here.
